Mali.title: Night rounds to secure IDP sites
Mali.summary: In Gao, Macina, Bankass and Sévaré, IDPs and refugees face security challenges: theft of equipment, vandalism and lack of monitoring capacity. To protect their property and prevent incidents, some communities organize themselves into safety committees and multiply night rounds. But these local initiatives remain fragile and residents are demanding more protection .

Mali.title: 48 people were killed in Mali by an attack by a group affiliated with ISIS
Mali.summary: Forty-eight people were killed in the Menaka region in eastern Mali following an attack by a group affiliated with ISIS, a lawmaker told the Associated Press. Musa Asharatomani, a Tuareg leader and member of the National Transitional Council, said that ISIS fighters in the coastal province attacked the area on Sunday evening and until Monday morning, and the victims included children and the elderly.

Mali.title: Terrorism kills Mali.. 48 people killed in ISIS attacks
Mali.summary: About 48 people were killed in Mali by Daesh members, according to security and local sources. Two security sources and two Malian officials told Reuters that militants linked to ISIS had killed at least 48 people in the country, apparently in retaliation for an attack by government-backed forces including members of Russia's African Legion paramilitary group on suspected informants.

Mali.title: Menaka: at least 48 civilians killed in attacks on camps
Mali.summary: At least 48 civilians were reportedly killed on Sunday, October 18, in attacks on camps near Menaka in northeastern Mali. The Executive Office of the Idaksahak community accuses elements of the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISIS). This violence occurs in the context of clashes between rival armed groups in the region.

Mali.title: Attack by Islamic State-affiliated group in Mali kills 48 people, official says
Mali.summary: AP News

Mali.title: Mali: Violence in the centre of the country - “We fled by canoe in the middle of the night”
Mali.summary: Depuis le début du mois de septembre, le centre du Mali est le théâtre d'une recrudescence des violences qui a fait des dizaines de victimes et provoqué le déplacement de milliers de personnes. Face à ce nouveau flux de déplacés, Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) a mis en place une clinique mobile dans la ville de Macina, où converge un grand nombre de familles.

Mali.title: Massacre in Mali: Islamic State attacks the Idaksahak community in the Menaka region
Mali.summary: Massacre in Mali: Islamic State Tackles Idaksahak Community in Menaka Region The Islamic State terrorist attack claimed the lives of at least 48 civilians in the Menaka region of Mali. This massacre, targeting the Idaksahak community and perpetrated in retaliation for military operations, marks a tragic escalation. At least 48 civilians were killed by fighters of the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISS) (ex-Islamic State in the Greater Sahara) on Sunday, October 18, in Tagadayat, in the Menaka region of northeastern Mali.

Mali.title: Mali: more than forty civilians killed Sunday by armed men (security and local sources)
Mali.summary: More than 40 civilians were killed on Sunday in attacks by armed men in the Menaka region of northeastern Mali, causing population displacement, several security, local and associative sources told AFP on Monday. These bloody attacks, carried out by armed men arrived on motorcycles, targeted, according to these sources, several camps belonging mainly to the Daoussahak community, from which the armed movement "Movement for the Salvation of Azawad" (MSA), close to the junta in power in Bamako, came.

Mali.title: Militants Kill 50 Civilians in Mali in Retaliation for 'Azawad Movement'
Mali.summary: ملخص قال مصدر أمني إن المسلحين "أطلقوا النار على كل ما يتحرك، وقُتل 50 مدنياً، بينهم شباب وكبار في السن"، مشيراً إلى أن نازحين فروا من العنف بدأوا بالوصول إلى ميناكا أمس الإثنين، وتحدث مسؤول محلي عن عدد أكبر من القتلى، قائلاً إن الحصيلة "تتخطى 50 قتيلاً، بينهم نساء وكبار في السن". قُتل 50 مدنياً بهجمات شنها مسلحون نهاية الأسبوع الماضي على مخيمات في منطقة ميناكا شمال شرقي مالي، وفق ما أفادت مصادر أمنية وأخرى محلية وكالة الصحافة الفرنسية أمس الإثنين.

Mali.title: Macina hosts more than 3,400 displaced people after the September violence
Mali.summary: RIGHT NOW More than 3,400 displaced people have reached Macina after the violence that occurred in September in several localities in the Ségou region, according to a report published on 16 October by Médecins Sans Frontières. MSF cites an attack in Souleye on September 1 and another in Touara on September 15. The identity of the authors and the complete human toll remain to be established .

Mali.title: More than 40 civilians killed in armed attack in northeast Mali
Mali.summary: More than 40 civilians have been killed in attacks by militants on camps in Mali's northeastern Menaka region, AFP quoted security and local sources as saying. The sources reported that the attackers used motorcycles to reach camps inhabited mostly by members of the Dussaq tribe, whose executive body accused the Islamic State of being behind the killings. According to the sources, the Dussac tribe is the cradle of the armed “Movement for the Salvation of Azawad”, allied with the government, in Bamako.

Mali.title: Mali: more than forty civilians killed Sunday by armed men
Mali.summary: Mali: more than forty civilians killed on Sunday by armed men More than forty civilians were killed on Sunday during attacks perpetrated by armed men in the Ménaka region, in northeastern Mali, causing population displacements, several security sources, local and associative, told AFP on Monday These bloody attacks, carried out by armed men arrived on motorcycles, targeted, according to these sources, several camps belonging mainly to the Daoussahak community, from which the armed movement "Movement for the Salvation of Azawad" (MSA), close to the junta in power in Bamako, came.

Mali.title: Kati: a prayer session in memory of the victims of the crisis
Mali.summary: The Minister of Religious Affairs, Worship and Customs, Dr. Mahamadou Koné, took part, on Sunday, October 18, 2026 in Kati, in a prayer and sacrifice session organized by the military hierarchy in memory of the civilian and military victims of the crisis in Mali . The ceremony was attended by Major General Oumar Diarra, Minister Delegate to the Minister of Defence, military officials and bereaved families.

Mali.title: MENAKA: 48 civilians killed in Daesh attacks
Mali.summary: "At least 48 civilians were killed on Sunday, October 18, 2026, in an armed attack in the locality of Tagadayat, in the region of Menaka". The information was reported yesterday, Monday, October 19, 2026, by the executive office of the Idaksahak community, which attributes this attack to armed men affiliated with the Islamic State group (Daesh). Source: The Renewal Indicator

Mali.title: Defence and Security: 678 young soldiers trained and presented to the flag in Koutiala
Mali.summary: Brigadier General Harouna Samaké, Governor of the Koutiala region, today formalized the end of the training course for 678 soldiers of contingent 2025, in a ceremony marked by the presentation to the flag. After six months of Basic Common Training (FCB), these 678 recruits – out of the 680 initially hired – have successfully completed their course .

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Justice: Opening of the combined hearings of the correctional and criminal chambers of the Military Court of Mopti
Mali.summary: Mopti, October 20 (AMAP) The work of the combined hearings of the correctional chamber and the criminal chamber of the Military Court (TM) of Mopti, for the year 2026, began on Monday, October 19, 2026, at the headquarters of the said court in Sévaré, noted AMAP. Scheduled from 19 to 29 October, these hearings have 43 cases on the docket, involving 72 defendants including 69 military and 3 civilians .

Mali.title: Bamako: two suspects arrested in a burglary case involving more than 200 million FCFA
Mali.summary: The Police Station of the Shopping Center arrested, on the night of October 14 to 15, 2026, two individuals suspected of being involved in several burglaries of shops in Bamako and its surroundings . The operation was conducted under the direction of Chief Commissioner Josué Kamaté, assisted by his deputy, Commissioner Issa Kouma. The investigation, opened following several complaints, made it possible to identify 14 businesses victims of these acts, for a declared damage of more than 200 million FCFA .

Mali.title: More than 40 civilians killed in Mali attack blamed on Islamic State
Mali.summary: Security and community sources in Mali says more than 40 civilians were killed over the weekend in an attack by armed men on camps in the north-eastern Menaka region. They reportedly arrived on motorcycles and targeted camps mainly housing members of the Daoussahak community. The community's executive bureau has blamed the killings on the Islamic State group.

Mali.title: Menaka: Idaksahak community reports 48 civilians killed in Tagadayat
Mali.summary: Menaka: the Idaksahak community reports 48 civilians killed in Tagadayat The Idaksahak community reports the death of 48 civilians in an attack attributed to Daesh elements on Sunday, October 18, 2026, in the locality of Tagadayat, in the Menaka region. Injuries are also reported, according to a statement from its executive office issued on October 19 According to this organization, the attackers arrived on motorcycles and the violence caused many families to flee.

Mali.title: Mali: more than forty civilians killed Sunday by armed men
Mali.summary: More than forty civilians were killed on Sunday in attacks by armed men in the Menaka region of northeastern Mali, causing population displacement, several local and associative security sources reported on Monday, October 19. These bloody attacks, carried out by armed men arrived on motorcycles, targeted, according to these sources, several camps belonging mainly to the Daoussahak community, from which the armed movement "Movement for the Salvation of Azawad" (MSA), close to the junta in power in Bamako, came.

Mali.title: Mali. Human Rights Watch denounces war crimes on both sides
Mali.summary: The American NGO calls on the African Union, which it asks to "take measures to prevent further atrocities. In a statement issued on Monday, October 19, it accused the Malian armed forces and Islamist and separatist armed groups of committing serious violations of the law of war since July “The Malian army and its ally, the Russian-controlled Africa Corps, have killed and injured dozens of civilians in attacks and in detention, in violation of international humanitarian law.

Mali.title: Mali: dozens of civilians killed in the northeast
Mali.summary: Mali: dozens of civilians killed in northeast APAnews - African News Agency

Mali.title: Mali: about forty civilians killed Sunday by armed men in the Ménaka region
Mali.summary: Published on: Advertisement In Mali, the Executive Office of the Idaksahak community expressed Monday "its strong emotion and immense dismay" after the death of 48 civilians of the community, last Sunday, on the side of Tagadayat, in the Ménaka region According to their statement, "these defenceless civilian populations were attacked by armed elements of Daesh [Islamic State group, editor's note], arrived on board several motorcycles".

Mali.title: Gunmen Kill 40 Civilians in Mali
Mali.summary: More than 40 civilians have been killed in attacks on settlements in Mali’s northeastern Menaka region, with security and community sources reporting that armed men targeted camps over the weekend. The attackers, reportedly travelling on motorcycles, raided several camps largely inhabited by members of the Daoussahak community. The community’s executive bureau blamed the Islamic State group for the killings.

Mali.title: Geneva: Mali celebrates the 66th anniversary of its independence in a spirit of national solidarity
Mali.summary: While in Geneva, Switzerland, as part of the 77th session of the Executive Committee of the Programme of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR), the Minister of Territorial Administration and Decentralization, Government Spokesperson, Brigadier General Issa Ousmane COULIBALY, chaired the ceremony to celebrate the 66th anniversary of Mali's independence on October 17, 2026 The ceremony took place in the presence of Mali's Ambassador to Switzerland Sékou dit Gaoussou CISSE, surrounded by his counterparts from Burkina Faso and Niger, as well as members of the Malian community based in Geneva.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strike near Menaka and Douentza
Mali.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike two terrorist positions near Menaka and Douentza Thanks to the exploitation of precise intelligence, the Malian Armed Forces carried out targeted strikes on 17 and 18 October 2026 against positions of terrorist armed groups. These operations illustrate the continuation of efforts to monitor, recognize and secure the national territory .

Mali.title: Mali: more than 40 civilians killed in armed attacks in the North-East
Mali.summary: Mali: more than 40 civilians killed in armed attacks in the Northeast On Sunday, armed men on motorcycles targeted several camps belonging mainly to the Daoussahak community, near Menaka, in northeastern Mali.

Mali.title: Mali: more than forty civilians killed Sunday by armed men (security and local sources)
Mali.summary: More than 40 civilians were killed on Sunday in attacks by armed men in the Menaka region of northeastern Mali, causing population displacement, several security, local and associative sources told AFP on Monday. These bloody attacks, carried out by armed men arrived on motorcycles, targeted, according to these sources, several camps belonging mainly to the Daoussahak community, from which the armed movement "Movement for the Salvation of Azawad" (MSA), close to the junta in power in Bamako, came.

Mali.title: 40 civilians killed in attacks on camps in Mali's Menaka region Armed men on motorcycles storm camps housing members of Daoussahak community, killing dozens and forcing residents to flee.
Mali.summary: More than 40 civilians have been killed in weekend assaults by armed men on residential camps across Mali's northeastern Menaka region, security and community sources confirmed. The assailants arrived on motorcycles, storming settlements primarily housing members of the Daoussahak community approximately 50 kilometres from the town of Menaka, in and around the village of Tinabow and the Tagadayat area.

Mali.title: Image Posted on October 19, 2026 Africa Killing in Mali: At least 48 civilians killed Sunday by jihadists At least 48 civilians were killed Sunday in attacks by jihadists in the Ménaka region of northeastern Mali, provoking…
Mali.summary: Aerial view of the city of Menaka, November 22, 2020 in Mali At least 48 civilians were killed on Sunday during attacks perpetrated by jihadists in the Menaka region, in northeastern Mali, causing population displacement, according to a new report communicated Tuesday to AFP by concordant sources Since 2012, Mali has been plagued by a deep security crisis fuelled by violence from groups affiliated with Al-Qaeda and the Islamic State (IS) organization, as well as community-based criminal groups and Tuareg independence movements.

Mali.title: Image Published on October 19, 2026 Africa Mali: More than forty civilians killed Sunday by armed men (security and local sources) More than forty civilians were killed Sunday during attacks perpetrated by armed men in the Menaka region, in northeastern Mali…
Mali.summary: A burning tanker truck is abandoned in the middle of the road leading to Sikasso, Mali's second largest city, on May 26, 2026 More than 40 civilians were killed Sunday in attacks by armed men in the Menaka region of northeastern Mali, causing population displacement, several security, local and community sources told AFP on Monday.

Burkina Faso.title: 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces: the contribution of the military reserve discussed
Burkina Faso.summary: The Minister of State, Minister of War and Patriotic Defence, Major General Célestin Simporé, chaired the launch conference of the commemorative activities for the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces, on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, in Ouagadougou. Burkina Faso's armed forces will blow out on November 1, 2026, their 66th candle . Thus, as part of the commemoration of this anniversary, several activities are on the agenda.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: Government reinstates the death penalty
Burkina Faso.summary: The Burkinabe government officially announced its intention to reinstate the death penalty in December last year. It had been abolished in 2018. “This legislative reform aims to strengthen public order, consolidate the fundamental values of the Nation and ensure the safety of people and property,” the Ministry of Justice wrote in a Facebook post "At the end of the votes, the Alp unanimously adopted the new law on the Penal Code in Burkina Faso," he said.

Burkina Faso.title: Death penalty in Burkina Faso: crimes covered by the new Penal Code
Burkina Faso.summary: Eight years after abolishing it, Burkina Faso is putting the death penalty back into its legislation. The People's Legislative Assembly (Alp) unanimously adopted, on Tuesday, October 20, 2026 in Ouagadougou, a revised Penal Code that replaces that of 2018 . The Minister of Justice and Human Rights, Edasso Rodrigue Bayala, presented the text on behalf of the government, with the stated objective of ensuring the safety of people and property.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso junta reinstates death penalty
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso’s ruling junta has reinstated the death penalty, the justice ministry said Tuesday, following a unanimous vote by the West African country’s unelected legislature. The new penal code reintroducing capital punishment, which had been abolished in 2018, “aims to strengthen public order, consolidate the nation’s fundamental values and guarantee security for people and property”, the ministry said.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso Reinstates Death Penalty
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso‘s junta has reinstated the death penalty, the justice ministry said Tuesday, following a unanimous vote by the West African country’s unelected legislature. The new penal code, reintroducing capital punishment, which had been abolished in 2018, “aims to strengthen public order, consolidate the nation’s fundamental values and guarantee security for people and property”, the ministry said.

Burkina Faso.title: Image Published on October 20, 2026 Africa Burkina Faso junta reinstates death penalty Burkina Faso reintroduced the death penalty into a new Penal Code on Tuesday, after a unanimous vote of unelected members of the Assembly...
Burkina Faso.summary: The head of the ruling junta, Captain Ibrahim Traoré (c), on October 15, 2022 in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso Burkina Faso on Tuesday reintroduced the death penalty into a new Penal Code, after a unanimous vote of the unelected members of the People's Legislative Assembly (PLA), which serves as Parliament in this junta-run country . At the head of the military regime that came to power at the end of September 2022 by a coup d 'état, Captain Ibrahim Traoré governs the country with an iron fist.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: the death penalty reinstated by the junta eight years after its abolition
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso reintroduced the death penalty into a new Penal Code on Tuesday, October 20, after a unanimous vote of the unelected members of the People's Legislative Assembly (PLA), which has served as a parliament in the junta-run country since late 2022. The military regime, led by Captain Ibrahim Traoré, had officially announced its intention to reinstate the death penalty in December last year .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: the junta reinstates the death penalty
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso: Junta Reinstates Death Penalty Unanimously by unelected members of the People's Legislative Assembly (PLA), which has served as Parliament since 2022, the death penalty has been reintroduced in a new Penal Code . Skip the ad Skip the ad Burkina Faso on Tuesday reintroduced the death penalty into a new Penal Code, following a unanimous vote of unelected members of the People's Legislative Assembly (PLA), which has served as parliament in the junta-run country since late 2022 .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina/Justice: The death penalty reintroduced in the Penal Code, penalties increased
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina/Justice: The death penalty reintroduced into the Penal Code, sanctions revised upwards The Minister of Justice and Human Rights, Me Edasso Rodrigue Bayala, defended, this Tuesday, October 20, 2026 before the parliamentarians of the People's Legislative Assembly (Alp), the bill revising Law No. 025-2018/AN of May 25, 2018 on the Penal Code in Burkina Faso At the end of the votes, the Alp unanimously adopted the new law on the Penal Code in Burkina Faso, with the reintroduction of the death penalty (which had been abolished on 31 May 2018).

Burkina Faso.title: Bobo-Dioulasso: A 13-year-old child dies on a gold mining site abroad, an alleged trafficker arrested
Burkina Faso.summary: Bobo-Dioulasso: A 13-year-old child dies at a gold mining site abroad, an alleged trafficker arrested The Regional Child Protection Brigade (BRPE) of Guiriko presented, on Monday, October 19, 2026, the results of an investigation into alleged acts of kidnapping and trafficking of three minors conducted at a gold mining site in a neighboring country. One of them, aged 13, lost his life .
